comments.author: @TravelHorizon-4K
comments.text: These engineering feats are mind-blowing, but is anyone thinking about the maintenance costs in 30–50 years? Glass bridges suspended thousands of feet in the air or sea-crossing high-speed rails exposed to salt corrosion will cost billions annually just to remain safe. Are these huge long-term expenses really worth the actual practical value they bring?
